name: Bloodfields: Rifts
summary: The Discord‑ruptured edge of the Bloodfields, dominated by unstable rifts and arcane storms.
description: Bloodfields Rifts is the most unstable part of the warfront. Discord energy has torn open rifts in the terrain, creating arcane storms, warped gravity, and unpredictable manifestations. Muramite forces attempt to harness the rifts for strategic advantage, while resistance agents seek to disrupt or collapse them. The area is extremely hazardous, with shifting ground, sudden surges, and entities born directly from Discord.
